# ghost/paint

Fossify Paint (F-Droid): draw lines and fill areas on a canvas by percent coordinates, pick a colour, set the brush size, read back the ink coverage and colours. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/paint
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/paint new_drawing --device <serial> --param confirm=<confirm>
ghost skill run ghost/paint set_color --device <serial> --param color=<color>
ghost skill run ghost/paint draw_path --device <serial> --param points=<points>
ghost skill run ghost/paint fill --device <serial> --param x=<x> --param y=<y>
ghost skill run ghost/paint get_canvas --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_drawing`: Start a new drawing
- `set_color`: Switch the drawing colour to red
- `draw_path`: Draw a triangle
- `fill`: Fill the triangle
- `get_canvas`: What is on the canvas?
